title.en: Tachometer illustrates the note on Power Cell Diesel 60 Concrete Pump Prints
title.zh: 「轉速表」用来说明柴油60型混凝土泵的动力格子印了什么

description.en: Power Cell Diesel 60 Concrete Pump Prints. 144 kW stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Tachometer.
description.zh: 柴油60型混凝土泵的动力格子印了什么。144 kW仍在目录格子里。插图来自「轉速表」。

h1.en: Tachometer illustrates the note on Power Cell Diesel 60 Concrete Pump Prints
h1.zh: 「轉速表」用来说明柴油60型混凝土泵的动力格子印了什么

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 60 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Diesel Engine (Power) is 6105 / 144 kW. An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tachometer.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油60型混凝土泵的动力文字写成：柴油机功率是6105 / 144 kW。画面「Check valve」的主体是法兰d 喷嘴 inconel 单向阀 or axial 单向阀。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tachometer。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tachometer. The image subject is Speedometer. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 60 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Diesel Engine (Power) is 6105 / 144 kW. It does not change this power entry, and a diesel code is not copied onto an electric row. Theoretical Output remains 35 m³/h. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. A larger motor entry is not a longer pipeline.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tachometer。画面内容是Speedometer。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油60型混凝土泵的动力文字写成：柴油机功率是6105 / 144 kW。液压泵 Kawasaki double pump 100。

heading.en: In automobiles, trucks, tractors and aircraft
heading.zh: 在汽车、卡车、拖拉机和飞机上

body.en: An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. Diesel Engine (Power) is 6105 / 144 kW. Max. Outlet Pressure remains 30 MPa. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 100.
body.zh: 画面「Check valve」的主体是法兰d 喷嘴 inconel 单向阀 or axial 单向阀。

body.en: A diesel entry names the engine line that is actually shown. Electric drive and diesel drive are different supplies. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not lift kilowatts or an engine code out of that frame. Main-unit weight is 3500 kg.
body.zh: 它不改这一格动力，也不会把柴油机代号抄到电动行上。

body.en: The frame “Check valve” shows Flanged nozzle inconel check valve or axial check valve. Use the label on this sheet, not the neighbouring model's label. If this row has no voltage entry, none is invented. Those entries, when shown, stay in their own columns.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械不从这一帧里提取千瓦或发动机代号。

question.en: What power text does Diesel 60 Concrete Pump list?
question.zh: 柴油60型混凝土泵的动力文字是什么？

answer.en: Diesel Engine (Power) is 6105 / 144 kW. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tachometer.
answer.zh: 柴油机功率是6105 / 144 kW。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tachometer画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can a diesel code be moved onto this row?
question.zh: 可以把柴油机代号挪到这一行吗？

answer.en: Only if this row already lists it. Otherwise the entry stays as written. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tachometer.
answer.zh: 只有这一行已经标出了才能算。否则格子保持原样。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tachometer画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What are output and pressure on this sheet?
question.zh: 这一页的输送量和压力是多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 35 m³/h. Max. Outlet Pressure is 30 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tachometer.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是35 m³/h。最大出口压力是30 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tachometer画面里印出的数字。
